description: The dollar and share change per name to move a pasted positions export to target weights, as a list. Weights are a share of investable capital (positions + cash on hand - cash reserve). Each row: current $ and %, target %, dollar change, shares at the last price, direction, and whether exiting it would realize a gain or harvest a loss (from unrealized P&L; holding periods are not in a positions export, so short- vs long-term is not known). A target with no holding and no price is sized in dollars only. Arithmetic only: no order is placed or previewed. Nothing pasted is stored. Example: {"positions_csv": "symbol,quantity,last_price,total_gain\nAAPL,120,229.80,5940\nKO,200,70.10,-210", "target_weights_pct": {"AAPL": 30, "KO": 30, "VTI": 40}, "cash_on_hand": 10000, "prices": {"VTI": 301.55}}.

cash_on_hand.description: Uninvested cash (default: a cash row in the export, else 0)

cash_reserve.description: Cash to keep out of the allocation (default 0)

positions_csv.description: Positions export as CSV text, header row included

prices.description: Symbol -> price, for targets not currently held

sell_unlisted.description: Also exit held names absent from the targets (default false)

target_weights_pct.description: Symbol -> target weight in percent (30 = 30%); 0 is a full exit
